method: count of ommatidia on ethanol-preserved workers from sympatric populations, compared with M. intrudens by Mann-Whitney U test (Table 2 title: 'Morphological comparison between Monomorium brachypterum and M. intrudens in overlapping populations, using the Mann-Whitney U-test statistic'); the Methods do not say which specimens were counted, which side, or whether the count is per eye
conditions: Worker caste, 20 workers of the new species from sympatric populations (Methods: 20 workers, 20 queens and 28 males of M. brachypterum, all from sympatric populations; M. intrudens 15 workers from sympatric populations plus 10 from non-sympatric). Contrary or partly conflicting numbers printed in the same paper: the Results text gives M. brachypterum 12.1 +/- 1.55, range 10-15, N = 20 (agrees with Table 2) but M. intrudens 16.6 +/- 1.29, range 14-19, N = 25, while Table 2 gives M. intrudens mean 16.67, SD 1.23, range 15-19, N = 15 and the Remarks give 15-18; the Mann-Whitney result is Z = 4.932, p = 8.13E-07 (M. brachypterum workers have fewer ommatidia). Worker description: 5-6 ommatidia in the longest row. Queen and male blocks of Table 2 have no ommatidia row. The holotype is a queen (KMNHSKYC25-01); these counts are for the 20 workers, not for a type specimen.
